observations: Three photos show multiple desktop towers wrapped in plastic, stacked together.
Photo 0 and 1 show three black towers with yellow sticky notes labeled 'CORE i3', 'CORE i5', and 'CORE i7' with specs like '3.7 GHz', '500 GB HDD', '4GB RAM', '6th Gen'.
Photo 2 shows two white towers with HP branding visible: 'HP' logo and 'ELITE DESK' text on the front panel.
One white tower has a yellow sticky note: 'CORE i7 3.0 GHz, 500 GB HDD, 8GB RAM, 6 GEN'.
The towers appear to be in a storage or resale environment, with cables and other items visible in the background.
The seller claims 'Uk used Hp desktop pro desk/ Elite desk' with Core i3, i5, i7 options, but photos show both HP and Dell towers.
The Dell logo is visible on one of the black towers in photo 0 and 1.
